name: Toaru Kaijin no Katsudou Kiroku
original_name: とある怪人の活動記録
source:
A new breed of humans who can easily morph their bodies is starting to take over.
In this world, being a mutant is just another job. Even so, our main guy GAG is an underachiever. He keeps trying to level up, but nothing ever works out.
Then one day, a once-in-a-lifetime chance shows up...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ275262.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
一种可以轻松改变身体的新型人类正在开始占据主导地位。
在这个世界上，变种人只是另一份工作。即便如此，我们的主角GAG却是个后进生。他一直在努力提升自己的水平，但始终没有成功。
然后有一天，一个千载难逢的机会出现了……
